value.rationale: A natural two-parameter family of lattice polytopes has many active subset facets. The theorem identifies the sharp, unbounded regime in which every additional non-simplex inequality is invisible to maximal-volume inscribed ellipsoids, pinpoints the failure for every complementary nontrivial parameter pair, gives the exact volume, and classifies the sharp boundary where new tangencies appear. These are geometric structure and threshold information, not merely a restatement of the known simplex John formula.
